flags.why: Chị em commonly refers to women collectively, including women who are unrelated ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/ch%E1%BB%8B%20em%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: Add: noun | women; women as a group. Example: Chị em trong cơ quan thường ăn trưa cùng nhau. = The women at the office often have lunch together.

flags.why: Nương vào nhau meaning to rely on each other remains current usage and is not archaic ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-n%C6%B0%C6%A1ng)).
